title: GTA 6: Rockstar Releases 39 New Screenshots Two Weeks Before Launch
description: To celebrate being two weeks away from launch, Rockstar Games has released 39 new screenshots for GTA 6, as reported by IGN. Check out the latest details.
author: GTA6 Hub Editorial
content:
## GTA 6: Rockstar Releases 39 New Screenshots Two Weeks From Launch

With the highly anticipated launch of *Grand Theft Auto VI* just two weeks away, Rockstar Games has treated fans to a massive visual update. According to a recent report by IGN, the developer has officially released 39 brand-new screenshots to mark the milestone countdown to the game's release.

### A Visual Showcase Ahead of Release

While the release of the screenshots is primarily a celebratory gesture for the two-week countdown, they offer fans another close look at the game's stunning visual fidelity and expansive open-world environment. As excitement reaches a fever pitch globally, these newly unveiled images provide plenty of details for the community to analyze while the final days tick down.

### The Final Countdown Begins

As the launch window rapidly approaches, the gaming community's anticipation is at an all-time high. IGN's coverage of this latest drop highlights just how significant every piece of official media is right now. For millions of players worldwide, the wait for the next chapter in the iconic franchise is almost over.

## Editor's Take

Releasing 39 screenshots precisely two weeks before launch is a brilliant move by Rockstar Games to supercharge the final stretch of hype. It rewards dedicated fans with fresh visuals while keeping the conversation entirely focused on the game's incredible aesthetic. The countdown is officially on, and the excitement is palpable.
